newsitem.title: USA: NCRA to restart unit at Kansas refinery next week.
newsitem.headline: NCRA to restart unit at Kansas refinery next week.

text.p: The National Cooperative Refining Association (NCRA) said it would restart a catalytic cracking reformer next week at its 74,000 barrel per day refinery in McPherson, Kansas.
The unit was shut Monday after a fire, according to the company.

"The follow-up inspection of the unit has been completed and unit repairs are underway. All repair work is to be completed in the next couple of days and the unit should be back up next week," a company spokesman said.
